• Average response changed from 910.014 us to 909.179 us (-0.09%); performance was effectively unchanged.
• Final mu decreased from 5.813900 to 5.342528 (-8.11%), and SSD host-WAM range changed by -8.59%.
• Redirect operations increased from 69 to 151 (118.84%); migration remained zero.
• Mapping entries increased from 13,108 to 838,860 (64.00×), the main cost of the smaller zone.
• Host/cumulative WAM, flash page programs, and approximate flash WAF were unchanged because no migration-copy writes occurred.
• Conclusion: one-stripe zones improved final balance modestly but required substantially more redirect activity and mapping metadata.

values: Source\gun_stripezone_swans; C++ source is identical to gun_swans (160/160 hashes match). Only experiment configuration and executable naming differ.
The implementation validates SWANS zones against Stripe_Unit_LBA. Zone=Stripe therefore means 512 LBA = 256 KiB per stripe unit, not the four-SSD full stripe of 2,048 LBA.
Both runs use the same 500,000-request MSRC prxy0 trace, SSD count 4, OP 20%, cache off, 40 s epochs, and SWANS thresholds 5/15.
SWANS_Zone_Size_LBA changed 32,768 → 512 and Zone_Stripe_Multiplier changed 8 → 1. Other archived input values are unchanged.
Results use the trace's original nanosecond timing. The stripe-zone simulation completed all requests successfully.
WAM values are 512-byte sectors; cumulative WAM = host write sectors + migration restore write sectors.
SWANS_Last_Mu is the implementation's final imbalance metric. Per-SSD host-WAM range is separately calculated from raw SSD sector counts.
Neither real-time run crossed the migration path; migration operations and migration WAM are zero in both results.
Smaller zones create more mapping entries. The workbook reports entry count, not measured host memory bytes or CPU overhead.
No bad blocks or flash erases occurred. Approximate flash WAF is a short-run programming proxy, not a physical lifetime estimate.
Output XML and input XML are stored under XML_result\gun_stripezone_swans, and every archived file is hashed in Source Files.
